plan: Deep-copy recipe, request, and catalog on entry so neither public function can mutate its inputs; print_original returns authored_text verbatim.

Compute the exact scale factor target_yield / recipe.yield with fractions.Fraction and apply it to every ingredient quantity, including ingredients added by substitutions and ingredients inside components.
Sort catalog indices by (priority, original position) once; selection for any excluded name is the first match in that order, giving deterministic tie-breaking.

Resolve each ingredient with a substitution chain loop: while its name is excluded, pick the best catalog choice, apply name/quantity_factor/unit/preparation, and record the choice id in application order; a missing choice yields a 'no substitution for NAME' reason.

Detect cycles with a per-chain visited-name set; additional ingredients spawned by a choice inherit a frozen copy of the spawning chain's set, so indirect reintroduction loops also terminate with 'substitution cycle involving NAME'.

Process ingredients through a FIFO worklist so additional ingredients from substitution results are subject to the same exclusions and catalog, enabling chained adaptations; emit a warning when a substitution reintroduces an excluded ingredient.

Accumulate cross-cutting effects (wording_changes pairs, equipment additions/removals) in an ordered effects state; apply wording pairs as ordered string replacements over main and component instruction lines, and equipment edits over a set.

Collect all reasons independently (every unsubstitutable exclusion, every cycle, every piece of final equipment missing from available_equipment) instead of stopping at the first, then return recipe=None with sorted reasons, or the adapted recipe (target yield, sorted equipment, reworded instructions) with empty reasons; warnings are sorted, choices stay in application order.

Verify the contract with a __main__ self-test: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion warning, three simultaneous impossibility reasons, priority-based determinism, byte-exact print_original, and input non-mutation.
mechanisms: ordered effects accumulator for wording and equipment edits
independent exhaustive reason collection with sorted output
